about: Ratcheted pass-rate floors of the oracle scorecard (test/browser/oracle-scorecard.test.ts): per sample with an oracle SVG in graph-io/test/fidelity/oracles/, per property of test/fidelity/oracle/compare-oracle.ts. Recording keeps the higher of the stored and the measured rate, so a floor is never lowered; an accepted drop goes in allowedDrops as "<sample>/<property>": "<reason>".

allowedDrops.xgmml-syn-bypass/edge.arrowWidth: Measured against an ngraph layout before the file's stored positions were kept; that fit (scale 0.357, mirrored, unrelated) made graphty's arrowheads look Cytoscape-sized. With the stored drawing kept the rate is 0.200, the same as cx-syn-bypass (0.206), the same network as CX: graphty's arrowheads are too wide (the arrowhead sizing issue, I01).
allowedDrops.xgmml-syn-bypass/edge.dash: Measured against an ngraph layout before the file's stored positions were kept. With the stored drawing kept, one more edge (1273064->1273048, dashed in Cytoscape) is matched and fails the same way its CX copy does in cx-syn-bypass (0.966 on both).
